overall_goal: Prepare, bake, and monitor the fish cakes in the oven

goals.description: Prepare the baking tray with aluminum foil
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a baking tray from the oven and lines it with aluminum foil.

goals.description: Place fish cakes onto the baking tray
goals.rationale: The person opens the packaging of the fish cakes and arranges them on the prepared baking tray.

goals.description: Put the baking tray into the oven
goals.rationale: The person places the baking tray with the fish cakes into the oven to start baking.

goals.description: Flip the fish cakes and return them to the oven
goals.rationale: The person takes the tray out of the oven to flip the fish cakes with a spatula, then returns them to the oven.

goals.description: Check on the fish cakes and adjust cooking
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly checks the fish cakes, shakes the tray, flips them again to ensure they are cooked through, and adjusts the oven temperature.
